# Economics policy organic sample (quota-core #80)

These rows are redacted, production-derived post-#334 task-attribution samples:
token/cache values and task shapes were copied from completed organic rows, while
task IDs, project, repository, path, session and context identities were replaced
with neutral values. They prove the policy consumes measured values without
committing private fleet metadata. They are input to shadow recommendations only,
not evidence that any recommendation is safe to enforce.
